gaps.text: ACI supplies no upgrade history; a conformant deployment can still be Stage 0.
Nothing attested tells a client whether a host forces attested serving; guard is opt-in and invisible pre-send.
Session list serves abbreviated entries whose ids do not hash to the listed content.
Compatibility rule constrains bytes not meaning; legacy endpoint attests any model name.
Reference CLI prints ACCEPTED, collapsing integrity with unmet policy claims.
Chain terminates at an unreproduced build; reproducible builds not required for conformance.
Rewrite signal is a boolean, on for all traffic; client cannot apply a rewrite policy.
